write_up: This is a strong teaching resume! Your work at Lincoln Heights shows classroom teaching, reading growth, curriculum training and grade-level leadership, with enough detail to make the work concrete.

The reading growth line is the standout: it names the district assessment, the change and the period over which it happened. Your grades, Washington certification and English Language Learner endorsement are also easy to find.

Leave the classroom and leadership details in place. Add what you did on the positive behavior support committee, and consider naming the teaching changes behind the reading growth if you can. Your resume makes a strong case; the competitiveness of a particular job will matter too.
